name: opennow-native
description: Native Windows client for OpenNOW (C++ / WinUI 3 / DirectX 10)

webrtc.description: Production media transport. Without it the client builds with the diagnostic test-pattern transport.

notes: The Core library has no external dependencies: JSON, hashing and Base64 are implemented in-tree so CI can build and test on Linux.
HTTP uses WinHTTP (part of Windows) rather than curl or OpenSSL.
libwebrtc is not published on vcpkg; see BUILD.md for how to link a prebuilt libwebrtc for the production transport.
